page-margin.description: Left and right page gutters on every route. Matches the grid margin — always use this, never a raw value. 16 mobile / 32 web.

section-gap.description: Vertical space between major page sections — hero to intro, intro to treatment grid, grid to CTA band. 48 mobile / 80 web.

block-gap.description: Between content blocks inside a section — heading group to card grid, paragraph cluster to image. 32 mobile / 40 web.

card-padding.description: Internal padding on treatment cards, condition cards, FAQ panels, practitioner bios. 16 mobile / 24 web.

card-padding-loose.description: Featured cards, methodology callouts, testimonial panels. 24 mobile / 32 web.

content-gap.description: Between related text elements — overline to heading, heading to body, label to input. 12 mobile / 16 web.

stack-gap.description: Between repeated items in a vertical list with no padding of their own — plain rows, FAQ items, form fields. Skip if the item already carries its own padding (e.g. Dropdown Item); that padding sets the rhythm instead. Fixed at 16: list rhythm should not change by platform.

grid-gap.description: Between cards in a grid or horizontal rail. Matches the grid gutter. 16 mobile / 24 web.

inline-gap.description: Between elements on one line — icon to label, button to button. Fixed at 8. Also the minimum gap between adjacent touch targets.

component-padding.description: Internal padding on buttons, inputs, chips, badges, select fields. 12 mobile / 16 web. With type/label this yields a 46px button — clears the 44px minimum.

micro-gap.description: Tightest relationship: badge internals, title-to-caption pairs (dropdown items, condition rows) — visually tighter than content-gap because both lines read as one unit. Fixed at 4.

small.description: Checkboxes, small tags, colour swatches, inline code, image thumbnails under 48px. 4px, identical on both platforms.

medium.description: THE DEFAULT. Buttons, inputs, selects, textareas, treatment and condition cards, FAQ panels, dropdown menus. 8px — deliberately not a pill, which would read as wellness-franchise rather than physician-led.

large.description: Modals, mobile bottom sheets, featured cards, methodology callouts, image containers. 12px.

xl.description: Full-bleed rounded sections, hero image containers, the longevity programme block. 24px.

pill.description: Filter chips, condition tags, category badges, avatars, toggle switches, progress dots. Fully rounded — only for shapes that are genuinely pill or circular.

max-width-container.description: Outer bound for all page content, centred. Beyond 1440 the extra viewport width becomes page margin, not layout. Uncapped on mobile. Wraps every route.

max-width-text.description: Long-form reading measure — treatment descriptions, condition copy, about text. 512px on web is 71 characters at 16px Public Sans (measured, avg char 7.22px, representative prose sample), inside the 65–75ch constraint. Uncapped on mobile. On desktop the remaining container width holds the related-conditions rail, in-page nav, and booking CTA.

max-width-narrow.description: Single-column forms — the intake flow, booking form, newsletter signup, error and empty states. 400px on web keeps forms from sprawling; uncapped on mobile where the viewport is the constraint.

header-height.description: Fixed site header height. Sticky on both platforms. 64 mobile / 80 web.

sticky-bar-height.description: Mobile persistent booking bar at the viewport bottom. Add this to bottom page padding so the last element is never covered. 0 on web — the bar is mobile-only.
